notes.summary: Complete independent reading of manuscript page 64 / scan 65. All lines were checked against both drafts using the whole-page layout view, each supplied half once, and seventeen own tight crops. The reading retains uncertain small/canceled marks and supplies the open Cor. 2 insertion enclosure in TikZ. The most substantial proposed corrections to C concern the validity-group segmentation, the scope of the les correction, and the alleged isolated canceled f at the end of suivants.
notes.math_reading_decisions: The repeated map context and the later word image made the final connector mathematically consequential and triggered crop 15. Its ink did not supply a complete arrowhead, so the dash-first uncertainty was retained. The opening existential question did not justify removing the small mark by F: F_0/F is retained. No statement was proved or computationally tested; reading a corollary is not counted as mathematical validation.
notes.author_checks: Confirmed cancellations of the old Cor, sauf, pres-like start, donc, deux, suivants, cases a and b, Alors il, and both de-like groups. The validity-group and les correction extents remain explicitly uncertain. All insertions and their placement are recorded. No outside-page assumptions or earlier mathematical results were imported.
notes.title_dates_pagination: Handwritten page number 64 at top center; scan marker 65 retained. No title, date, archive sheet number, stamp, or letterhead is visible. No independent mathematical diagram appears; the one graphic is the open editorial enclosure connecting the added Cor. 2 label to its continuation. marked_in_h=yes denotes an uncertainty/illegibility/editorial note at the locus, not merely a struck-state macro.
